title: Paow · vändning P4 · med mellanbild

step.label: Nyp, ett kort till platsen och tillbaka

from.built: första bilden + kortet P4.C1 där planen säger

preview.note: Kortet ritat på Pamelas ankare 2.1 för att visa var och hur stort det landar. Ritas om på Paows ankare 2.1 när den är godkänd i Material.

drawn.as: flatQuad från P4.C1 (planens plana bord, som labbet ritar)

reference.why: Ingen referensfilm. Mallen som höll hade bankens tur och retur till samma plats som referens; den klipps inte här än.

prompt.text: One continuous take with a locked-off camera and no cuts. The woman in the first frame is a young, slim, petite woman with a platinum-blonde chin-length bob, warm-coloured tattoos on her throat and upper chest and a small white flower pendant, in a black tailored blazer over a cream V-neck top; she sits at a green table, seen from the front, with the black card shoe fixed at the right of the picture and a yellow card in its window. She deals one card and comes back to the pose she started in. Her left hand, at the right of the picture, pinches the yellow card in the shoe's window between thumb and forefinger, as in the first frame, and draws it out: the card looks as it does in the shoe, the same size and shape, one plain rigid card. The same hand carries it low over the table towards the place where it will lie. On the way she turns the card over once, the way a real hand can from this pinch: one natural movement of fingers and wrist that a human hand can actually make, the card held firmly the whole time, until its blue face is up. Halfway there, her hand and the card look exactly as in the reference picture. She lays it flat, blue face up, exactly where the blue card lies in the last frame, in the middle of the picture, at the same size and angle, lets go of it, and the card stays there. Then the hand returns to the shoe and pinches the next yellow card, exactly as in the first frame. Her right hand, at the left of the picture, rests on the table the whole time. Only one card moves; it is solid yellow on its back and solid blue on its face. She ends exactly as in the last frame. Nothing of this happens: a second card appears, a finger passes through the card, the card grows or shrinks on its way, a hand hovers in the air without holding or laying anything, the shoe changes, the picture cuts or the camera moves.

cost.basis: 21,3 krediter per s × 4 s. Liggarna b19 och b20: 7 s i 1080p = 149 krediter; listpris 23,5 per s i verktyget generate_video 2026-11-12.

notes: Provet ur planen (bestall-plan, Kortets vändning): fyra Kling 4-tagningar vid plats 4, två med bara text och två med mellanbild; varje tagning mäts (tools/flip-axis.ts) och rutgranskas.
Uppskattat: 4 s tur och retur är kort. Mallen som höll var 7 s med referensfilm, och bankens giv till P4 tar 3,5 s bara fram till landningen.
Antaget: hur Kling 4 lägger en referensbild mellan första och sista bild är inte prövat; b4a/b4b visade att en bildlista läses i tidsordning.
